September 26, 2026 degree-three Gersten construction, audited independently of the September 25 manuscript.

definitions.L,V,pi: L=Q_5(zeta_5), V=O_L, pi=1-zeta_5, with zeta_5 primitive.
definitions.X,C,m: X is the projective V-hypersurface P=(X-Z)^5-X*Y^4+Y^5+zeta_5*Z^5; C=X_L; m=[0:0:1] on the special fiber.
definitions.S,D,t,eta,q0: S=A/yA, t=x mod y, D=Frac(S), eta=1-t, q0 is the point Y=0 on C with field D.
definitions.coefficients: K_i(B;Z/5)=pi_i(K(B) smash M_5), and likewise G. rho is coefficient reduction and partial_coef is the coefficient connecting map.
definitions.beta,a_D,c: Fix any beta in K_2(L;Z/5) with partial_coef(beta)=[zeta_5]; beta_E=res_E(beta); a_D=beta_D*[t]; c=j_*b for the asserted integral lift b in K_3(S).
definitions.theta,lambda: theta_E(u)=beta_E*[u] on E^*/E^{*5}; lambda=(v_L mod 5) theta_L^{-1}, if theta_L is an isomorphism.
definitions.T,U_h: Sigma=R minus m, U_h=Spec R[1/pi,1/h] for h in Sigma; T=Spec A[1/pi]=lim U_h. T is not assumed to be an open of C.
definitions.valuation: All v_E are normalized to value one on a uniformizer; f(E/L)=[k_E:F_5], not [E:L].

definitions.arithmetic: N=Q(zeta_5), S=Z[zeta_5,1/5], u=zeta_5-1, Delta=Gal(N/Q), chi(delta)=a when delta(zeta_5)=zeta_5^a.
definitions.local_fields: k0=F_{5^4}, k=F_{5^8}; H0/Q_5 is unramified of degree 8, V=O_H0, L=H0(zeta_5), O=O_L.
definitions.uniformizer: t in O satisfies t^4=-5, t/u=1 mod u, delta(t)/t in mu_4(V) with reduction chi(delta).
definitions.D_curve,E_curve,h: D_curve/F_5 is X^4+Y^4=Z^4; E_curve is the smooth projective model of w^2=s^4+1; h has s=X/Y,w=Z^2/Y^2.
definitions.orbit_detector: g_a(X:Y:Z)=(aX:aY:Z); Z_infty=D_curve,k intersect {Z=0}; psi([Dprime])=[h_*Dprime-deg(Dprime)*(o)] in E_curve(k)/5.
definitions.lifted_point: Q in E_curve(k0) is not in 5E_curve(k), P in D_curve(k) maps to Q with Z(P) nonzero; coordinates X0,Y0 in V lift P=(X0bar:Y0bar:1) and X0^4+Y0^4=1.
definitions.Bott: beta has coefficient boundary zeta_5; b denotes multiplication by its restrictions, not the degree-three integral lift b.
definitions.specialization_notation: In prop:specialization, C and D instead denote the geometrically integral generic and special fibers of a smooth projective curve over the valuation ring of a finite extension L/Q_5 containing mu_5; B is any abelian group killed by 5.

contexts.statement: Uniform parameterized extension of the degree-three cyclotomic construction; proposed theorem, novelty and independent certification pending.

definitions.parameters: p is an odd prime, d>=1, p does not divide d.
definitions.base: H/Q_p is unramified of degree d, zeta_p is primitive, L=H(zeta_p), V=O_L, pi=1-zeta_p, residue field F_(p^d).
definitions.model: Xcal/V is (X-Z)^p-X*Y^(p-1)+Y^p+zeta_p*Z^p=0; A_p,d is its local ring at m=[0:0:1].
definitions.divisor: S=A_p,d/y, t=x mod y, eta=1-t, D=Frac(S), T=Spec A_p,d[1/pi].
definitions.coefficients: K_i(-;Z/p) is Moore-spectrum K-theory; beta in K_2(L;Z/p) has integral coefficient boundary [zeta_p].

contexts.statement: Sign-corrected dyadic integral degree-three Gersten construction, with finite residue field; the accepted odd-prime proof is unchanged.

definitions.model: Q=2Z^2-2XZ+X^2+XY-Y^2; Xcal=Proj V[X,Y,Z]/Q; C=Xcal_L; R=V[x,y]/(2-2x+x^2+xy-y^2); B=R_(2,x,y).
definitions.divisor: S=B/yB, t=x mod y, eta=1-t, D=Frac(S), q0=(Y=0) on C, T=Spec B[1/2].
definitions.coefficients: K_i(-;Z/2)=pi_i(K(-) smash M_2), likewise G; only the mixed integral/coefficient operation is used, not a coefficient-ring product.
definitions.classes: partial_coef(beta)=[-1] in integral K_1(Q_2); beta_E=res_E(beta); a_D=beta_D*[t]; c=j_*b for the two integral lifts.
definitions.detector: theta_E(u)=beta_E*[u] on square classes; lambda=(v_2 mod 2) theta_L^(-1); f(E/L) is residue degree, never total degree.
definitions.failed_naive_substitution: The unchanged odd-prime formula at p=2 has divisor (t-1)^2-1=t(t-2), not an Eisenstein domain; the corrected signed equation is a different model.
definitions.family: For odd d, H/Q_2 unramified of degree d, V=O_H, B_d is the same local equation over V.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 209 ('An integral degree-three Gersten counterexample', unformalized in Lean), which claims that for X: (X-Z)^5 - X*Y^4 + Y^5 + zeta*Z^5 = 0 over Z_5[zeta] at m=[0:0:1], A=O_{X,m} is a 2D regular local ring where K_3(A) -> K_3(Frac A) has nonzero kernel: either (a) discover and certify a flaw, regularity/ramification error, symbol/transfer cancellation error, or invalid localization/detection step in sections/model.tex, sections/integral-class.tex, sections/field.tex, or sections/detection.tex with an exact symbolic certificate, or (b) independently verify and certify every algebraic, p-adic, and K-theoretic step with an exact replay certificate.

C is integral projective; A is a two-dimensional Noetherian regular local domain of mixed characteristic (0,5), pi in m_A^2. Every closed-point E/L extends over O_E and, if its specialization is not m, 5 divides [k_E:F_5]. S=V[t]/((t-1)^5+zeta_5) is a DVR with uniformizer t; D/L has ramification degree 5 and residue degree 1, N_D/L(t)=pi, (1-t)^5=zeta_5, and Y=0 gives the unique point q0. Source: D3 model.tex, lem:model, eq:divisor, eq:norm-t.

There is b in K_3(S) whose restriction and coefficient reduction is a_D. For j:Spec S->Spec A, c=j_*b has zero integral restriction to Frac A and c|_T mod 5=i_*a_D in G_3(T;Z/5). Source: D3 integral-class.tex, prop:integral, eq:steinberg.

For every finite E/L and every fixed beta with partial_coef beta=[zeta_5], theta_E:E^*/E^{*5}->K_3(E;Z/5), u->beta_E*[u], is an isomorphism. The weight-two edge identifies its value with alpha_E cup the Kummer class of u in H^1_et(E,mu_5^{tensor 2}); alpha_E is a nonzero weight-one element of H^0(E,mu_5). Source: D3 field.tex, lem:field, eq:theta.

For every finite E/L and u in E^*, Tr_E/L theta_E(u)=theta_L(N_E/L u). Hence lambda annihilates all transferred K_3(E;Z/5) classes if 5 divides f(E/L). Source: D3 field.tex, lem:norm-detector, eq:transfer.

For all h,k in R minus m, U_hk->U_h is affine flat; T=lim U_h and colim G_3(U_h;Z/5)=G_3(T;Z/5). Each U_h contains every closed point specializing to m, including q0. Its complement consists of finitely many closed points E_q with 5 dividing f(E_q/L). Source: D3 detection.tex, lem:opens, eq:continuity.

The class w=(q0)_*theta_D(t) restricts nontrivially to G_3(T;Z/5): otherwise coherent localization on some U_h gives an omitted-point relation, whose proper pushforward has detector value both 1 and 0. Source: D3 detection.tex, proof of thm:main, eq:omitted-relation.

For the ring A in D3_CTX there exists c in K_3(A) with c|_Frac(A)=0 but c|_A[1/pi] mod 5 nonzero; A is regular local of dimension two and pi in m_A^2. In particular integral Gersten injectivity fails in degree three and c is not in 5K_3(A). The order and rational image of c are not determined. Source: D3 introduction.tex, thm:main.

A=(V[x,y]/(5+x^4+y^4))_(5,x,y) is a two-dimensional Noetherian regular local domain and ker(K_5(A)->K_5(Frac A)) is nonzero. Source: D5 introduction.tex:18-31, thm:main. Inventory only; not a degree-three input.

The mod-five Moore spectrum has the claimed unique unital pairing M smash M->M; multiplication by 5 is zero, coefficient K and G groups are F_5-vector spaces and admit natural products. Source: D5 coefficients.tex:48-87, lem:moore-product. Unverified.

Multiplication by beta in K_2(R;5) commutes with the G-theory localization maps and boundaries, finite pushforward and flat pullback, using restricted beta on residue terms. Source: D5 coefficients.tex:89-123, lem:bott-localization. Unverified.

Let H be perfect of characteristic not 5, containing a primitive fifth root, and partial_coef beta_H=[zeta_H]. Bott multiplication is an isomorphism K_{2r}(H;5)->K_{2r+2}(H;5) for r>=1 if cd_5 H<=3, and K_{2r+1}(H;5)->K_{2r+3}(H;5) for r>=0 if cd_5 H<=2. For finite H it is an isomorphism in all nonnegative degrees; over algebraically closed H even groups are generated by Bott powers and odd groups vanish. Source: D5 coefficients.tex:125-285, lem:bott. Unverified.
An element of K_2(N)/5 whose tame residues vanish at every closed point of Spec S is zero. Source: D5 arithmetic.tex:108-163, lem:cyclotomic-unramified. Unverified.
K_4(S)[5]=0. Source: D5 arithmetic.tex:165-305, lem:cyclotomic-k4. Unverified.

There exists c in K_5(S) with reduction b^2[u]_5, and (delta c) mod 5=chi(delta)^2 b^2[delta u]_5 for each delta in Delta, compatibly with every field restriction. Source: D5 arithmetic.tex:307-337, prop:integral-lift. Unverified.

There exist Q in E_curve(k0), P in D_curve(k), Q not in 5E_curve(k), h(P)=Q, Z(P) nonzero, and sum over a in F_5^* of a^2 psi([g_a P])=4Q nonzero in E_curve(k)/5. Source: D5 geometry.tex:101-154, lem:orbit. Unverified.

The ring A is regular local of dimension two, and x->tX0,y->tY0 defines a surjective local map A->O with nonzero height-one kernel generated by Y0*x-X0*y. Source: D5 geometry.tex:239-289, lem:local-ring. Unverified.

T=Spec(A tensor_V L) is a regular integral Noetherian one-dimensional scheme flat over A; the base-changed divisor splits into four L-points with affine coordinates delta(t)X0/t,delta(t)Y0/t and specializations g_chi(delta)(P). Source: D5 geometry.tex:300-356, lem:splitting. Unverified.

Let L/Q_5 be finite containing mu_5, R its valuation ring, and X/R a smooth projective relative curve with geometrically integral fibers C and D. Let U be a localization of the coordinate ring of a nonempty affine open of C, containing distinct L-rational p_i. Let finite Z subset D contain every specialization of a closed point omitted from U; let psi:Pic(D)->B, 5B=0, kill [r] for r in Z. If beta_L has coefficient boundary zeta_5 and sum e_i v_L(a_i) psi([r_i]) is nonzero, then sum (p_i)_*(e_i b^2[a_i]_5) is nonzero in G_5(U;5). Source: D5 specialization.tex:11-225, prop:specialization. Unverified.

For every regular local B and nonzero regular parameter g, the appendix upper-left-block assignments fail to send all the specified lower-triangular isomorphisms of upper-triangular S_2 objects to target-diagram morphisms. This is a source-only obstruction to a particular construction, not a refutation of its cited theorem. Source: D5 claimed-vanishing.tex:88-145, lem:triangular-naturality-failure. Unverified and independent of D5_MAIN.

claims.natural_statement: The stated B is dimension-two Noetherian regular local with residue F_2, maximal ideal (x,y), and ord_m(2)=2. Its projective generic conic C is integral. S=Z_2[t]/(t^2-2t+2) is a DVR with uniformizer t; D=Q_2(i) has ramification index 2 and residue degree 1, eta=1-t has eta^2=-1, and N_D/L(t)=2. Every closed point of C specializing away from m has even residue degree.

For every finite E/Q_2 and every fixed beta with integral coefficient boundary [-1], the actual mixed product theta_E:E^*/E^{*2}->K_3(E;Z/2), u->beta_E*[u], is an isomorphism. The weight-two edge identifies it with alpha_E cup Kummer(u), alpha_E the nonzero element of H^0(E,mu_2). K_3(E;Z/2) has exponent 2 as a consequence; no exponent assertion on K_2(E;Z/2) or Moore ring structure is assumed.

The supported coefficient class a_D=beta_D*[t] lifts first to integral K_3(D), since {-1,t}=2{eta,1-eta}=0, and then to b in K_3(S), since K_2(F_2)=0. Its coherent pushforward c in K_3(B) is integrally zero over Frac B and rho(c|_T)=i_*a_D.
